The LegalBench project is an ongoing open science effort to collaboratively curate tasks for evaluating legal reasoning in English large language models (LLMs).
LegalBench is a benchmark consisting of different legal reasoning tasks
The hearsay task, for which the input is a description of some evidence and the output is whether or not that evidence would be considered hearsay
The Rule QA task, for which the input is a question about the substance of a law, and the output is the correct answer to the question.
LegalBench tasks cover a wide range of textual types, task structures, legal domains, and difficulty levels.
Notably, LegalBench tasks have been assembled through a unique crowd-sourcing effort within the legal community.
LegalBench has also been augmented with tasks derived from existing legal benchmarks (e.g., CUAD)
LegalBench is ongoing and we are always looking to incorporate more tasks.
